title: Compute zonal polynomials from the partition recurrence

source.citation: Lin Jiu and Christoph Koutschan, Calculation and Properties of Zonal Polynomials, arXiv:2001.11599

translation.notes: Dominated integer partitions and the source recurrence are implemented directly with exact rationals. They reproduce both the displayed C_(2,1)(a,b,c) and the larger coefficient c_((5,4),(3,3,3)).
